args.name: Evidence-based food assessment
args.function: Assess an owned unfamiliar food sample for nutritional value and toxicity using a supported physical test, if one exists; distinguish measured findings from unresolved uncertainty without requiring blind consumption.
args.conditions: Hazelnuts have been directly observed nearby, but their nutrition and toxicity remain unknown. A single sample is being collected. Roots and red berries are already known safe. Appearance alone must not certify safety.
args.inputs: An owned unfamiliar food sample; any other required materials or prerequisites must be specified rather than granted.
args.costs: Method, time, energy, sample consumption and equipment requirements are unknown; disclose them before testing.
args.effects: Provide a reusable testing interface only if a real supported method exists. Record only properties actually established by a physical trial, with limitations. If unsupported, report the missing mechanism; do not invent safety, nutrition or resources.

Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: one round and 0.2 energy, the baseline probe observation of a plot in reach (target). Remove: one round and 1 energy, planter only (target). details.effects: Completed planting places the real root unit in the plot; it keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Plot state records stage, observation rounds, soil moisture and temperature/rain exposure. There is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule for roots, so a plot never produces food. Inspect records only visible state. Remove returns only the material that physically remains, never a replacement; the emptied plot remains. Cancel releases unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for planting, inspecting or removing; genuine observed changes use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only.

value.name: Controlled food processing trial
value.function: Place one or two whole units of an owned food on the ground as a paired exposure trial, inspect their quantity and decay, end the observation or retrieve what remains.
value.costs: Start: inputStackId of an owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food, quantity 1 or 2 whole units (default 2), and an unoccupied ordinary-ground x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; two work rounds at one energy each. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: target trial in reach, one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve: operator only, one round and one energy. Cancel of an exposed trial ends observation at no cost. No supports, tools, water or fuel are used or granted.
value.effects: Completed setup places the samples at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions; with one unit there is no matched control. No food moisture, drying or preservation model exists in this world: both samples keep the existing decay rules, so no treatment difference, preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is produced. The trial records rounds exposed and marks a 10-round observation checkpoint; ageing continues while unattended and after the checkpoint. Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.
